paper_title: Axion dark matter from topological defects
coupling_convention: m_a in eV (lower bound), NDW=1 model
notes: This is a cosmological/theoretical paper computing axion dark matter abundance from topological defects (strings and domain walls) for post-inflationary PQ breaking. The main result is a lower bound on the axion mass m_a >= (0.8-1.3)x10^-4 eV for NDW=1 (Eq 4.6), corresponding to the requirement that axions not overclose the universe. It is not a haloscope exclusion limit with a coupling on the y-axis; the primary result is on the f_a-m_a (Fa vs bias) plane. Data points here encode the stated m_a mass-range bound (in eV). No standard coupling constant (g_agamma etc.) is constrained.
